canonical_question: What subjects are taught in the B.Tech. CSE (AI and ML) and Generative AI curriculum?
paraphrases: Semester-wise syllabus for B.Tech CSE Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at LPU; First year and second year CSE AI ML subjects
answer: Year 1 Autumn Term covers Python Programming, Orientation to Computing-I, Internet Programming Lab (HTML/CSS), Mathematics for Engineers, Basic Electrical & Electronics Engineering + Lab, and Engineering Physics. Year 1 Spring Term covers Computer Programming (C language), Database Management Systems (SQL & normalization), Differential Equations & Vector Calculus, Orientation to Computing-II, Software Engineering, Engineering Drawing with AutoCAD, Environmental Studies, and Language Elective 1. Years 2–4 progress through Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP with Java, Exploratory Data Analysis, Probability & Statistics, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Mathematical & Optimisation Techniques for ML, Applied Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI & Prompt Engineering, Backend Development with FastAPI, RAG & Vector Databases, Agentic AI, and Responsible AI.
